_about: Duplicate-finding pairs (issue #249). Each pair is two reviewer-style findings on the same fixture, labeled by what the inbox should do with them: same (one problem said twice: merge), related (one root cause, different actions, e.g. a bug and the missing test for it: group), different (separate problems: keep apart). Pairs are nearby in the file on purpose, because proximity alone can't tell these apart. Line numbers are head-side. The last four are harder on purpose: category and line position don't give the answer away.

a.claim: The expiry check is gone: access_token() returns the cached token whenever one exists, even after expires_at has passed.

b.claim: Callers can now receive an expired token, because the cached branch no longer compares expires_at with the current time before returning it.

b.claim: Unterminated frontmatter now silently succeeds instead of returning ParseError::Unterminated, so a document without a closing delimiter parses its entire body as YAML.
